boundary: Source identifies who supplied the active test; F2P/P2P class is based only on executed Base/Gold outcomes.

tests.purpose_en: Compile the real SCSS and use Chromium getComputedStyle to verify that + Add forward resolves to --color-link.
tests.purpose_zh: 编译真实 SCSS，并通过 Chromium 的 getComputedStyle 验证“+ Add forward”解析为 --color-link。

tests.purpose_en: Reject an over-broad implementation by checking that an unrelated link-button keeps its original computed color.
tests.purpose_zh: 验证无关的 link-button 保持原有计算颜色，防止修复范围过宽。

tests.purpose_en: Run the existing DomainOverviewPane test suite to preserve previously supported rendering and behavior.
tests.purpose_zh: 运行仓库既有 DomainOverviewPane 测试套件，保护原有渲染与交互行为。
